authoring_contract: Each section architecture needs distinct cross-section and meaningful visible construction—not relabeled cylinders.
No normal wire is automatically routed into a fluid-branch hollow Y; connector geometry depends on typed payload.
8-wire harnesses share public sockets, but internal cores vary natural slack deterministically and stay grouped.
All equivalent topologies use identical fixed comparison fixture port coordinates and normals.
Not all materials support branch topology naturally (e.g. optical fiber requires splitter); compatibility must be refused or handled with explicit component.
Material IDs are intents only until exact source-approved FMPL PBR assets are resolved.
No new workflow or implicit native Factorio fluidbox hookup.

F-source verified production materials and Factorio connection verification
